headline: Vietnam Real Estate Enters Top 10 Markets for Transparency Improvement
summary: Vietnam ranks 50th of 89 markets for real estate transparency in 2026. It is nonetheless among the 10 markets with the strongest improvement worldwide over the past two years.
why: Real estate transparency rankings measure how easily investors can access market data, which affects how confidently capital is allocated to property markets.
